tool.name: Muse
tool.description: Meta's consumer and small-business personal AI agent that keeps working on tasks in a secure VM and is reached via the Muse app or WhatsApp.
strengths: Reachable via app, web and WhatsApp
Approval before publishing, sending or spending
tool.pricing: Free for most use, with subscription plans for more (prices not published).
tool.statusNote: Consumer launch 2026-09-08 in the US (iOS, Android, web); small-business version launched 2026-09-29 in the US and Canada.
tool.practitionerNote: A consumer and small-business product, not an enterprise-managed agent: there are no published admin, audit or compliance controls. Suits sole traders connecting Shopify, QuickBooks or Meta ad accounts, not governed corporate data.

dataResidency.detail: No data-residency options stated; available in the US (and US/Canada for small business).

deployment.detail: Meta-hosted; tasks run on 'Muse Secure VM', a dedicated virtual machine.

auditLogging.detail: No audit logging described in the launch posts; controls are per-user app access and approvals.

soc2.detail: Consumer product; Meta has not published certification scope for Muse.

iso27001.detail: Consumer product; Meta has not published certification scope for Muse.

iso42001.detail: Consumer product; Meta has not published certification scope for Muse.

euAiAct.detail: Not yet offered in the EU; no classification published.
